ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that compiles natural language prompts into production-ready web application boilerplate within minutes for the 8-hour sprint.
ideas.title: QuickGen AI Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted specifically at the ultra-short 8-hour constraint of HackDay 1.0, prioritizing speed and instant working utility over complex features.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that analyzes GitHub pull requests and provides comprehensive security and style audits instantly.
ideas.title: Agentic Peer Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the trend of AI agents solving developer workflow problems, highly appealing to the hackathon's developer-centric audience.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered knowledge retrieval assistant that ingests API documentation and answers developer queries via an embedded widget.
ideas.title: InstantDoc Concierge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable pain point for international hackathon participants trying to quickly learn new tools under a strict time limit.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined global time zone coordination and synchronized countdown timer app designed explicitly for remote hackathon teams.
ideas.title: Global Pitch Timer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific logistics of a global online hackathon where participants struggle with tight deadlines across different time zones.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config dashboard that transforms raw JSON endpoints into interactive charts instantly through a single-line embedding.
ideas.title: FlashData Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate visual impact during judging demos, which is critical when evaluators are reviewing dozens of projects submitted in a single day.
